what: V_OD and V_OS of the committed `driver` subcircuit in both static data states, pre-emphasis disabled, over the G75 PVT grid. DC only.
closes_no_spec_row_reason: E1-E4 are statistical rows (G75 + local-mismatch Monte Carlo). The Monte Carlo is out of scope here, and E4's V_OS(PP) half is transient, so no row is closed by this bench.

stimulus.iref_rule: chosen once at tt/27 C/1.80 V/3.30 V as the 0.1 uA step whose V_OD lands on the 350 mV E1 design nominal (349.98 mV), then frozen across all 75 conditions
stimulus.gate_drive: 0 V / VCCD, both gates of a side on one node, tracks VCCD
stimulus.measured_at_note: the corrected pad_cell (cd0c89a, PR #108) is instantiated on all four output nodes behind ideal 0 V ammeters (issue #116). pad_cell is a shunt-only network with no series element, so the driver output and the pad are the same node; the graded expressions read those nodes unchanged. The shunt current itself is measured by two ungraded diagnostic observers (ishunt_p1, ishunt_n1). Pre-#116 this field said "driver output" with the cell deliberately omitted.
